headline: Bank of Ghana Pushes for Cheaper Cross-Border Payments in Africa
summary: The Bank of Ghana advocated for targeted measures to lower transaction fees and increase reliability for cross-border financial transfers across African nations during meetings in Singapore.
why: Lowering cross-border remittance costs is key to fostering regional financial integration under the African Continental Free Trade Area.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Policy initiatives to lower transaction friction support intra-African trade expansion.
